_about: Future Soldier-style tech. cost is in tech. Distances in metres, times in ms.

mark.name: Target Tagging
mark.desc: Tag the enemy under your crosshair; your squad sees them through walls for 8s.

hack.name: Terminal Hacking
hack.desc: Hack data terminals for intel and tech. Stand still for 5s.

sensor.name: Sensor Grenade
sensor.desc: Reveals everyone within 18m of where it lands to your squad for 10s — including cloaked players.

camo.name: Optical Camo
camo.desc: Near-invisible while crouched or moving slowly. Drains 1 tech every 2s. Firing or taking damage breaks it.

doorHack.name: Lock Bypass
doorHack.desc: Silently hack open a locked stash house door (8s). The owner is alerted.

rally.name: Rally (squad leader)
rally.desc: Leader only: restores 50% armor and gives +20% damage for 10s to squadmates within 30m. 90s cooldown.
